title: Sifat 1: pairs of opposite qualities: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y7 lesson 5 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Sifat 1 rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 5. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: Makhraj and sifat
points: Same place, different sifat: ط and ت

head: Not this
This
rows: ط: raised and pressed, full; ت: low and whispered

keywords.def: the qualities of a letter's sound
the tongue presses like a lid

questions.q: Give the sifat of ص in «صَبَبْنَا» (80:25).
questions.a: Hams, rakhawah, isti'la, itbaq, and safeer (whistle).

questions.q: Sifat grid (pupil PDF): give the quality from each pair for ق ط ت س د. Today's rota group recites 80:25 to 33 when learned, or 80:17 to 24.
questions.a: ق jahr/shiddah/isti'la/infitah; ط jahr/shiddah/isti'la/itbaq; ت hams/shiddah/istifal/infitah; س hams/rakhawah/istifal/infitah; د jahr/shiddah/istifal/infitah.

questions.q: Extend: write the hams and shiddah phrases.
questions.a: فَحَثَّهُ شَخْصٌ سَكَتَ; أَجِدُ قَطٍ بَكَتْ

questions.q: Stretch: which two qualities make a letter bounce (qalqalah)?
ط differs from ت because ط is ...
questions.a: A) raised and pressed (isti'la and itbaq). Same makhraj; ط has isti'la and itbaq, ت has istifal and infitah (and hams).

questions.q: Think again: ط and ت come from the same place. Why do they sound so different?
questions.a: Different qualities: ط is voiced, raised and pressed (itbaq); ت is whispered and lowered.
